_comment: Source registry for PARADIGM INTELLIGENCE. Data, not code.
Fields per entry:
key                    unique identifier, used by --source and the API
adapter                rss | jsonl | contact_page
source_type            trust tier (see below)
publisher              display name
enabled                whether a normal run includes it
confidence             0-1, confidence in the SOURCE, not in any one story
priority               0-100, higher runs first so the strongest source
claims a story before a weaker one does
rate_limit_per_minute  per-host politeness budget
max_docs               per-run cap (falls back to INGEST_MAX_DOCS_PER_SOURCE)
company_hint           set when a feed belongs to exactly one company
notes                  free text for operators, e.g. why it is disabled
options                adapter-specific (rss: feed_url, jsonl: path,
contact_page: url + company)
source_type, highest trust first: COMPANY, GOVERNMENT, PROCUREMENT,
BUSINESS_PUBLICATION, INDUSTRY_PUBLICATION, EVENT, PUBLIC_PROFILE, OTHER.
An event's own official website counts as COMPANY: it is that organisation's
own site. Third-party listing aggregators are EVENT.
EVERY ENTRY BELOW IS DISABLED, deliberately, and stays that way.
Spec rule: only mark a source active if it actually works. These are real,
high-value Egyptian and regional candidates, but whether each one resolves, is
a valid feed and permits automated access depends on the host running it - so
the file cannot answer it, and does not try to.
ENABLEMENT IS A DEPLOYMENT SETTING, NOT AN EDIT TO THIS FILE.
Set SOURCES_ENABLED to the keys that are to run, comma-separated. It replaces
the 'enabled' flags below entirely: exactly those keys run, everything else is
off. This file is mounted read-only in the container, so it could not be the
switch anyway - and one reviewable list of live sources is safer than a flag
per entry that can be left switched on after a source breaks.
Do not write that list by hand. Probe first, so a source can only be enabled
by demonstrating that it works:
python -m app.cli check-sources     verdict and advice for every entry
python -m app.cli enable-sources    the SOURCES_ENABLED line for the ones
that passed, and only those
A source reported READY_TO_ENABLE has been fetched and parsed successfully.
Confirm its terms of use and robots.txt permit automated access for this
purpose before leaving it enabled - that is the one check no probe can do.
The 'enabled' field below is still honoured when SOURCES_ENABLED is empty, so a
local checkout can switch one source on for development without the variable.
Government and official procurement portals are the highest-value sources for
Egyptian corporate signals and are tracked in docs/ROADMAP.md. Most publish
HTML rather than feeds and need a purpose-built adapter, which must not be
written speculatively against an endpoint nobody has been able to read.

sources.notes: UNVERIFIED. Official state news service; carries ministry-witnessed signings and openings. Confirm a feed endpoint exists before enabling - the site may be HTML only, in which case it needs an adapter, not this entry.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (Egypt)
sources.notes: UNVERIFIED. Strong for technology, telecom and data-centre signals. Confirm the feed path.
UNVERIFIED. Broad Egyptian business coverage. Check terms of use before enabling.
UNVERIFIED. State-affiliated English coverage; good on state projects. Confirm the business-section feed id.
UNVERIFIED. Sector-specific; strong on contract awards and project milestones in energy.
TEMPLATE, not a real source. Copy this per target company. A company newsroom is the highest-trust tier and company_hint means the extractor never has to guess the company.

TEMPLATE, not a real source. Points at a company's own public leadership or press-contact page. Only reads what the page publishes; it never derives an address from a name pattern. The company must already exist in the database.

Local newline-delimited JSON, for material an analyst supplies as documents. For a signal an analyst has already structured and verified, prefer POST /api/v1/ingest/signals, which records ANALYST provenance.
